Frequently asked questions

Who are the workshops for?

CEOs, leadership teams and decision makers who want to understand advanced AI and agentic systems and turn them into decisions, roadmaps and working pilots.

Where do they take place?

On-site in Norway, the Gulf or Egypt, or remotely. Other locations on request.

Which languages?

English or Norwegian. Other languages on request.

How does booking work?

Pick a workshop, tell me about your company and format, choose up to three preferred weekdays at least two weeks ahead, and add your goals. I confirm a date by email. You can also download a tentative calendar hold and follow up on WhatsApp.

Not sure which workshop fits?

Take the five-question AI readiness check above. It recommends a workshop and pre-selects it in the booking form.

What does it cost?

Scope and pricing depend on format and team size, and are agreed after a short conversation.
